cat > /home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u043/system/state/workspace/programs/task-20e73869.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # The two horizontal edge bars mark corresponding positions in the top and bottom rows.
    def spans(row):
        cells = [i for i, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
        if not cells:
            return []
        runs = []
        for c in cells:
            if not runs or c > runs[-1][-1] + 1:
                runs.append([c])
            else:
                runs[-1].append(c)
        return runs
    top = max(spans(grid[0]), key=len)
    bottom = max(spans(grid[-1]), key=len)
    marker = [(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if grid[r][c] != bg and r not in (0,h-1)]
    if len(marker) != 1:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    r,c,color = marker[0]
    offset = c - top[0]
    c2 = bottom[0] + offset
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rr in range(1, r):
        out[rr][c] = color
    out[r][c] = 4
    for rr in range(h-1):
        if out[rr][c2] == bg:
            out[rr][c2] = color
    return out
PY
